issues.detail: The Greek 'δετε' (dote) is an imperative meaning 'give', but the Vietnamese 'ban cho' implies a formal 'bestow' or 'grant'. More importantly, the Greek 'τω' (to) is missing in the Vietnamese translation, which changes the direction of the action: the Greek says 'give TO the one who has ten', whereas the Vietnamese simply says 'give the one who has ten'.
